buddhist-cathedral-default-11-table.what: A large Buddhist temple hall with a central Buddha altar, stone pillars, prayer wheels, and red meditation runners.
buddhist-cathedral-default-11-table.faith: Buddhism (East Asia / Tibet, medieval to modern)
buddhist-cathedral-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The Buddha is depicted in a traditional seated meditation posture on a lotus throne with an aureole, accompanied by eight-spoked Dharmachakra wheels, Tibetan prayer wheels, and traditional offering tables.

buddhist-temple-nave-default-11-table.what: A medium Buddhist temple hall with an altar, seated Buddha statue, prayer wheels, and meditation mats on a tiled floor.
buddhist-temple-nave-default-11-table.faith: Buddhism (East Asia / Tibet, medieval to modern)
buddhist-temple-nave-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The Buddha figure has the proper meditative posture, halo, and lotus base, while the eight-spoked Dharma wheels, prayer wheels, and lotus floor medallion accurately reflect Buddhist iconography.

buddhist-temple-shrine-default-11-table.what: A small Buddhist shrine room with a seated Buddha statue on an altar, prayer wheels, offering table, and lotus floor medallion.
buddhist-temple-shrine-default-11-table.faith: Buddhism (East Asia / Tibet, medieval to modern)
buddhist-temple-shrine-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The central Buddha statue has the correct meditative pose, lotus throne, and halo, appropriately accompanied by an offering table, ceremonial lamps, and prayer wheels.

christian-cathedral-default-11-table.what: A large Christian cathedral nave and sanctuary with an altar, crucifix, choir stalls, pulpit, pews, and a floor labyrinth.
christian-cathedral-default-11-table.faith: Christianity (Western Europe, medieval Gothic/Romanesque, c. 12th–15th century)
christian-cathedral-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The crucifix correctly depicts Christ in the traditional cruciform pose, and the altar arrangement, altar candles, choir stalls, pulpit, lectern, and historic Chartres-style floor labyrinth are liturgically accurate.

christian-temple-nave-default-11-table.what: A medium Christian chapel with an altar, crucifix, pulpit, pews, baptismal font, and a floor labyrinth.
christian-temple-nave-default-11-table.faith: Christianity (Western Europe, medieval to early modern)
christian-temple-nave-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The crucifix features the traditional corpus and is properly flanked by altar candles, a pulpit, lectern, pews, baptismal font, and an authentic medieval Christian floor labyrinth.

christian-temple-shrine-default-11-table.what: A small Christian prayer chapel with a crucifix, altar candles, prayer kneeler (prie-dieu), votive candle stands, and a floor labyrinth.
christian-temple-shrine-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The crucifix has the correct shape and posture, flanked by altar candles, a devotional kneeler, votive candle stands, and a medieval Christian labyrinth.

hindu-cathedral-default-11-table.what: A large Hindu temple hall (mandapa) with carved stone pillars, a central sanctuary shrine, ritual brass lamps, and Om wall plaques.
hindu-cathedral-default-11-table.faith: Hinduism (India / South Asia, classical to medieval / traditional)
hindu-cathedral-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The temple features authentic Dravidian/Nagara style carved pillars with bracket capitals, a stepped vimana shrine, traditional brass oil lamps (diyas), and accurately drawn Devanagari Om (ॐ) symbols.

hindu-temple-nave-default-11-table.what: A medium Hindu temple hall with carved pillars, a central shrine, brass oil lamps, and Om wall plaques.
hindu-temple-nave-default-11-table.faith: Hinduism (India / South Asia, medieval to modern)
hindu-temple-nave-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The shrine possesses a traditional shikhara tower, authentic carved pillars, tall brass standing lamps (kuthu vilakku), puja offering tray, and correct Devanagari Om (ॐ) symbols.

hindu-temple-shrine-default-11-table.what: A small Hindu shrine room (puja room/garbhagriha) with a central shrine, brass oil lamps, an offering plate, and a ritual bell.
hindu-temple-shrine-default-11-table.faith: Hinduism (India / South Asia, traditional / medieval to modern)
hindu-temple-shrine-default-11-table.accurate: Yes. The tiered shrine structure, ornate brass standing oil lamps (kuthu vilakku), puja thali with offerings, and ritual temple bell (ghanta) are drawn accurately according to Hindu worship traditions.

muslim-cathedral-default-11-table.faith: Islam (Middle East or North Africa, medieval to early modern period, hypostyle mosque style)
muslim-cathedral-default-11-table.accurate: yes, it correctly depicts a hypostyle prayer hall with stone columns, a central mihrab on the qibla wall with ablaq masonry, a minbar to the right of the niche, a rihal (Quran stand), rows of prayer rugs facing the qibla, hanging mosque lamps, and aniconic geometric decoration

muslim-temple-nave-default-11-table.faith: Islam (Middle East or North Africa, medieval to early modern period, Mamluk or Ottoman style)
muslim-temple-nave-default-11-table.accurate: yes, it correctly depicts the essential elements of an Islamic prayer hall: a concave mihrab (prayer niche) with traditional ablaq masonry on the qibla wall, a stepped minbar (pulpit) positioned to the right of the mihrab, a rihal (Quran stand), parallel rows of prayer rugs oriented towards the qibla, suspended mosque lamps, and strictly aniconic geometric ornamentation

muslim-temple-shrine-default-11-table.faith: Islam (Middle East or North Africa, medieval to early modern period, Mamluk or Moorish style)
muslim-temple-shrine-default-11-table.accurate: yes, it correctly depicts a small Islamic prayer room (musalla): it includes a central mihrab niche indicating the qibla with ablaq masonry, a rihal (Quran stand), a prayer rug facing the mihrab, hanging mosque lamps, and geometric ornamentation, with the minbar appropriately omitted for a small non-congregational room
